rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for predicting an outcome from available information.

example.english: I predict it will rain tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gu2 gai3 teng1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5

rows.note: Use this for a more deliberate forecast, especially about trends, results, or future events.

example.english: Experts predict that property prices will fall this year.
example.traditional: 專家預測樓價今年會跌。
example.jyutping: zyun1 gaa1 jyu6 cak1 lau4 gaa3 gam1 nin4 wui5 dit3

rows.note: Use this when the prediction is an estimate or expectation about what is likely to happen.

example.english: We predict that we will arrive before three in the afternoon.
example.traditional: 我哋預計下午三點前到。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jyu6 gai3 haa6 ng5 saam1 dim2 cin4 dou3

rows.note: Use this for foretelling a future event as a prophecy, especially in a mystical or religious context.

example.english: That prophet can predict when the end of the world will come.
example.traditional: 嗰位先知可以預言世界末日幾時到。
example.jyutping: go2 wai2 sin1 zi1 ho2 ji5 jyu6 jin4 sai3 gaai3 mut6 jat6 gei2 si4 dou3
